## About
Cal's love for automobiles began when he was a young boy in Lebanon. He worked in West LA and Redland, then came to the South Bay as lead mechanic for Jim and Jacks before starting C's Auto. These days he looks after loyal South Bay residents and workers.
We're a full service facility and can perform all dealer maintenance and repair. Bring your maintenance schedule so we can keep your routine service accurate. Our goal is simple: serve your car with integrity, flexibility in schedule and dealer quality service at a fraction of the cost.
Our customers rate us 4.8 from 79 Google reviews.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: Tracking down what's going on with your car.
- Brake Service: Brake work for domestic and foreign models.
- Shock and Struts: Shock and strut service and replacement.
- Engine light service: Finding out why the engine light is on.
- Cooling and Fan System: Service for the cooling and fan system.
- Radiator service: Radiator service as part of keeping your engine cool.
- Thermostat Service: Thermostat service and repair.
- Belts, valves and hoses service and replacement: Service and replacement for belts, valves and hoses.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service both domestic and foreign models, new and late models.

Q: Can you handle my regular scheduled maintenance?
A: Yes. We can perform all dealer maintenance and repair. Please bring your maintenance schedule so we get your routine service right.

Q: Do you do oil changes?
A: Yes. We do all forms of tune up, including a basic oil change.

Q: Where is the shop now?
A: We moved, so please make sure you have our updated address: 15020 Inglewood Avenue, Lawndale, CA 90260.
